title: Beyond Entity Recognition: Vision-Centric Knowledge Visual Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2611.25680v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose VC-VQA, a large-scale benchmark for vision-centric knowledge reasoning, aiming to systematically evaluate the capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in fine-grained visual knowledge acquisition and complex multi-stage reasoning. Unlike existing benchmarks that primarily treat visual information as entity recognition and rely on text-based external knowledge, VC-VQA explicitly models the role of visual information by considering both its source (internal vs. external images) and stage of involvement (pre-retrieval vs. post-retrieval). Specifically, VC-VQA requires models to retrieve external visual evidence, identify visual clues before retrieval, and localize, verify, or match retrieved knowledge against the internal image. We further construct a controlled multimodal knowledge base with traceable textual and visual evidence for each sample. We evaluate 21 representative MLLMs under four settings: no extern

translated_title: 超越实体识别：以视觉为中心的知识型视觉问答
translated_abstract: 我们提出了VC-VQA，一个面向以视觉为中心的知识推理的大规模基准，旨在系统性地评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在细粒度视觉知识获取与复杂多阶段推理方面的能力。与现有主要将视觉信息视为实体识别、并依赖基于文本的外部知识的基准不同，VC-VQA通过同时考虑视觉信息的来源（内部图像与外部图像）及其参与阶段（检索前与检索后），显式地建模视觉信息的作用。具体而言，VC-VQA要求模型检索外部视觉证据、在检索前识别视觉线索，并将检索到的知识与内部图像进行定位、验证或匹配。我们进一步构建了一个可控的多模态知识库，为每个样本提供可追溯的文本与视觉证据。我们在四种设置下评估了21个具有代表性的多模态大语言模型……
tldr: VC-VQA是一个以视觉为中心的知识推理大规模基准，通过要求模型检索外部视觉证据并将其与内部图像进行定位、验证和匹配，系统评估多模态大语言模型在细粒度视觉知识获取与多阶段推理上的能力。
